enchantments.tooltip: Freedom of Movement: This item grants its wearer the ability to move and attack normally while under the influence of magic that impedes movement, such as paralysis, solid fog, slow and web.
Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
Dexterity +14: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Exceptional Nimble Skills Bonus: +10 Exceptional bonus to Balance, Hide, Move Silently, Open Lock and Tumble.
Legendary Kundarak Delving Equipment: 3 Pieces Equipped: +3 Artifact bonus to Sneak Attack Dice. +15% Artifact bonus to Helplessness Damage. +15% Artifact bonus to Doublestrike and Doubleshot
Mythic Boot Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
